name: gradient-button-group
title: Gradient Button Group
description: An icon toolbar for jumping between app sections, with a sun button that flips the theme. The selected section drops into a recessed slot inside a thin animated gradient ring.
use: An app needs a compact, always-visible switcher between a handful of top-level sections.
avoid: Only four fixed icon slots exist and the items are hardcoded, so adding or renaming a section means editing the source.
a11y: Icon buttons carry aria-labels with aria-current on the active one, but there are no custom focus styles and the ring spin ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide near-black rounded tray holds four large square icon buttons - a grid, a bar chart, stacked layers and a server - then a sun button on the right. Inactive icons are dim grey; the active one is bright white inside a darker recessed cell edged by a thin cyan-to-lime ring.
behaves: Clicking an icon springs the recessed well and glowing ring to that cell while its icon brightens and the old one fades to grey. The sun swaps the whole bar between dark and light palettes, and the ring's gradient keeps rotating.
customise: No props: the four nav items, their icons, labels and both theme palettes live in the source, so changing sections is a file edit.
weight: light: Four SVG buttons, one spring layout animation and a CSS spin; idle otherwise.
demo: Four section icons (Dashboard, Analytics, Layers, Storage) and a sun button.
polishWhy: Layered recessed tray and a crisp glowing ring feel deliberate; icon-only labels stay clear.
